description: This file defines the Salary Data Transfer Object (DTO) class within the OrangeHRM project, used for retrieving and normalizing employee salary data, incorporating external services and filtering.

classes.name: Salary
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for representing and normalizing employee salary data within the OrangeHRM reporting module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Salary DTO with an optional employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Fetches employee salary data based on the employee number and returns it as a normalized array.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Defines the mapping of field names to the getter methods used to retrieve specific salary attributes.
